title: “Poverella” Style Courgettes

media.caption: Cut the courgettes into small rounds.
In a pan with plenty of oil, fry the courgettes for 2 minutes until they turn golden, turning them often during cooking.
Then place them on kitchen paper to drain.
In a bowl, dress the courgettes with the vinegar.
Leave them to absorb the flavours for at least 2 hours before serving.

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil for frying

healthBenefits.title: Low-Calorie Hydration
healthBenefits.text: Courgettes are about 95% water and low in calories, helping support hydration and weight management while providing volume to meals.

healthBenefits.title: Digestive Aid
healthBenefits.text: Fresh mint leaves contain menthol, which can soothe the digestive tract and reduce bloating or indigestion.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil is rich in monounsaturated fats and polyphenols that support cardiovascular health and reduce inflammation.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant Support
healthBenefits.text: Courgettes provide vitamin C and carotenoids that help neutralize free radicals and support immune function.

healthBenefits.title: Natural Preservation
healthBenefits.text: Vinegar's acidity helps preserve the dish naturally while adding tangy flavor without extra sodium or preservatives.

healthBenefits.title: Bone and Muscle Support
healthBenefits.text: Courgettes contain manganese and potassium, minerals important for bone health and proper muscle function.

_ingredientsText:
8 courgettes
	10 mint leaves
	white vinegar
	salt
	extra virgin olive oil for frying
_preparationText:
1 - Taglia le zucchine a piccole rondelle
2 - In a pan with plenty of oil, fry the courgettes for 2 minutes until they turn golden, turning them often during cooking.
3 - Then place them on kitchen paper to drain.
4 - Leave them to cool.
5 - In a bowl, dress the courgettes with the vinegar,
